biotools.summary: TRUEFAD is a user-friendly bioimagery tool for automatic morphometry measurement on muscle cell cultures and histological sections. Developed as a plugin for FIJI, it enables consistent measurement of myotube diameter and muscle fiber size, facilitating muscle research.
